description: COMMENT ON <object-type> ... IS '<text>' across every object kind, read back through SHOW/DESCRIBE cells; updating an existing comment; qualified names; special/quoted payloads; and the live-verified refusal shapes: missing database spelled bare, missing table/view/function fully qualified, missing COLUMN as a bare Object, missing table under a column reference as the qualified Table shape, and a signature matching nothing getting the plain does-not-exist without the argument list. Converted 1:1 from ddl/CommentCommandTest (now retired).
